meaning.zh:
“狂欢” 或 “尽情欢乐”。

这个短语的起源没有确定的记录，但一些传说追溯到19世纪，据说有一群人在一次狂欢中涂红了镇上的建筑物，象征极度的狂欢和放纵。因此，当人们说要去 "paint the town red"，意思是要出去狂欢、不留遗憾地尽情享乐。
meaning.en: This phrase does not have a definitive origin, but some tales trace it back to the 19th century. One story involves a group of merrymakers who painted the buildings of a town red, symbolizing extreme revelry and indulgence. Therefore, when people say they are going to "paint the town red," it means they plan to go out and have a wild, unforgettable time.

lines.en: After finishing the project, they decided to *paint the town red* to celebrate.
lines.zh: 完成项目后，他们决定去狂欢庆祝。

lines.en: We're going to *paint the town red* for your birthday tonight!
lines.zh: 今晚我们会为你的生日狂欢庆祝！

lines.en: After receiving his promotion, he wanted to *paint the town red*.
lines.zh: 升职后，他想要出去大肆庆祝一番。
